description: This file is a test script written in Shell for testing Git notes prune operations. It defines a series of test cases to create commits with notes, verify their presence, perform pruning operations, and validate the results.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, with the provided description and commands.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the timestamp for commit creation to simulate different commit times.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files or variables to verify they are identical.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the executed command is expected to fail.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script, signaling completion.
